tables.name: fct_crop_condition_weekly
tables.description: USDA crop condition per state and week, one column per rating class.

columns.name: good_excellent_change
columns.description: Points of good/excellent gained or lost since the previous report.

tables.name: fct_price_daily
tables.description: Daily OHLCV per futures contract with returns and 20-day realized volatility.

columns.name: daily_return
columns.description: Simple return vs the previous trading day.

columns.name: realized_vol_20d
columns.description: Annualised stddev of 20 daily log returns. Null until 20 returns exist.

tables.name: fct_weather_state_daily
tables.description: Daily weather per corn belt state, averaged over stations with a complete day.

tables.name: mart_corn_belt_weekly
tables.description: Weekly corn price, heat units and crop condition, for signal analysis.

columns.name: next_week_corn_return
columns.description: The following week's return, so a row can be read as signal -> outcome.

columns.name: states_reporting
columns.description: Crop Progress states (max 18 for corn) with a rating that week.

tables.name: rpt_quarantine_daily
tables.description: Count of records rejected by contract checks, per contract, day and reason.

tables.name: ref_crop_progress_states
tables.description: The 18 states per crop that USDA's national Crop Progress report rates. NASS also publishes condition for minor states (CT, RI, VT...); averaging those in with equal weight would drown out the states that set prices.

tables.name: ref_symbols
tables.description: Futures tickers we ingest and the commodity each one prices.
